handling_by_name.Brier complete ranking: Use the same spectral population, hierarchy and paired resampling indices. A Brier zero, tie or reversed ranking cannot change spectral membership.
handling_by_name.config/experiment-only superpopulation: Preserve the frozen across-seed-mean construction. For a group nonempty somewhere, its twenty-seed mean requires a defined group estimate at every seed; averaging only its populated seeds is prohibited. A group empty at all twenty seeds remains explicitly spectrally empty. Partial seed support makes the required across-seed group mean undefined. Do not substitute a different aggregation order to avoid this.
handling_by_name.hierarchical seed then config/experiment: Retain every selected seed occurrence and its prescribed within-seed config/experiment draws. Respect repeated group draws. If a selected seed occurrence loses all support for a required source/kind, that replicate is undefined.
handling_by_name.leave-one-config/experiment-out: Delete the identified group across seeds; retain every other scheduled group. If any retained seed/source/kind becomes empty, that deletion estimate is undefined. Retain deletion records for originally empty groups too.
handling_by_name.leave-one-seed-out: Compute all twenty prescribed nineteen-seed estimates. The named deletion is the permitted perturbation; no additional seed may be removed. Primary nonvacuity guarantees spectral support in the retained seeds.
handling_by_name.seed-only fixed census: Resample complete paired seed blocks. Once primary nonvacuity holds, spectral emptiness cannot newly arise from seed-only sampling.
handling_by_name.separate EXP-112 and G2x: Report each source's own twenty-seed estimate. A separate-source diagnostic does not transfer weight in the combined estimand or rescue primary vacuity.
handling_by_name.two-way pigeonhole seed by config/experi: Preserve the selected seed and group multiplicities, including their prescribed joint weights. A selected required seed/source/kind with zero supported group weight makes the replicate undefined.

Complete census and joins: all scheduled groups and invocations, planned exclusions with reasons, seeds, sources, kinds, stable contexts and recorded steps; distinguish accepted attempts from retries and named labels from experiment groups.

Spectral evidence: original-basis coefficient evidence, active-coefficient counts, inclusion mask, context identities and links to structural completeness and control results; persist degenerate and included contexts.

Every hierarchy level: total, eligible, nondegenerate and degenerate counts; nonempty/empty invocation and group counts; identities of every empty child; numerical denominators, applicable weights and intermediate means; distinguish zero or tie from undefined.

All required seed/source/kind cells: explicit records even when empty, source estimates, combined estimates and every primary vacuity witness; kind-specific ledgers preserve paired context identity without double-counting.

Sensitivity membership: method, grain, source stratum, statistic, replicate/deletion index, sampled indices and multiplicities, paired draw linkage, support counts, denominators and estimates; preserve existing RNG audit bindings.

Undefined-result ledger: typed null plus a closed reason code and exact empty-population witness; no NaN sentinel, omitted array entry or numerical zero substitute; prescribed, defined and undefined replicate/deletion counts reconcile exactly.

Branch audit: all applicable preemptions, vacuity witnesses, sensitivity reversal and non-evaluability causes, unrounded comparison inputs and selected branch; every statistic carries its count summary and detailed-census reference.
